sections.title: Sound of the letter bé
paragraphs: The letter name is (bé) /be/. Its main sound is heard in the word (balle) /bal/, which means ball. This letter can make two different sounds, or stay silent.

sections.title: How to say bé
paragraphs: For the first sound, close both lips firmly to stop the air. Release them suddenly while your voice is on. Put a hand on your throat to feel it shake. For the second sound, keep the same mouth movement, but keep your voice off.

sections.title: Spelling of bé
paragraphs: In most positions, you say this letter as in (robe) /ʁɔb/. Before a voiceless consonant, assimilation turns it into the sound heard in (obtenir) /ɔp.tə.niʁ/. At the end of some words, it is a silent letter, as in (plomb) /plɔ̃/.

sections.title: Comparing bé to English
paragraphs: This sound is very close to the English sound in bed. Start your voice right as your lips part, without puffing out extra air.
